data_loss: SmoothL1 in physical flux units, beta=10.
validation: Last 20% of observed dates within the training fires; unweighted arcsinh MSE.
history: Newest strictly earlier satellite observation within 7 days, past-week mean excluding today, age and availability.
repairs: Spatial/wind pairs must have equal absolute UTC date and fire ID; self-pairs excluded.
Longitude distances use mean-latitude cosine; transport vector points from source to destination.
Decay normalization uses mean absolute predicted flux with a 1 ng floor.
Effective physics penalty is 1000*log1p(raw/1000), replacing the hard zero-gradient ceiling.
pair_only_ablation: Nonnegative and decay weights set to zero because these assumptions conflict with some signed labels.
caveat: History NN intentionally uses prior satellite observations from the held-out fire as prediction-time covariates; its labels are excluded from training/validation.
provenance_note: History NN and legacy PINN started with initial_code_sha256. Final physics_loss change wires stable decay only for repaired arms and skips zero-weight decay. Legacy settings have stable_regularization=False and decay weight 0.1, so the legacy calculation is unchanged. Repaired and pair-only runs restarted from scratch. Superseded incomplete outputs are excluded.
